links.outcome: Whether the model's self-declared confidence (1-5) tracked answer correctness on exam questions
links.effect: Correct answers were significantly more often given with higher confidence (p < 0.001), suggesting self-assessment could indicate answer accuracy.
links.quote: The analysis of the confidence level revealed that correct answers were significantly more often provided with higher confidence (p < 0.001), suggesting that the model's self-assessment could be an indicator of answer accuracy.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance and self-reported confidence of ChatGPT-4o on the Polish ophthalmology specialization examination without testing a clinical deployment practice or safeguard.
